article.headline: Jacob Dar, Jaxson Thompson help Rice fend off Lamar 85-81 at Jacksonville Classic
article.description: — Jacob Dar totaled 23 points and 11 rebounds and Jaxson Thompson scored 20 to help Rice hold off Lamar 85-81 on Sunday at the Jacksonville Classic.
article.linkText: Jacob Dar, Jaxson Thompson help Rice fend off Lamar 85-81 at Jacksonville Classic
article.story: JACKSONVILLE, Fla. -- — Jacob Dar totaled 23 points and 11 rebounds and Jaxson Thompson scored 20 to help Rice hold off Lamar 85-81 on Sunday at the Jacksonville Classic. Dar made 6 of 8 shots, including all three of his 3-point attempts, and 8 of 10 free throws for the Owls (4-2). He also blocked four shots and had three steals. Thompson made 7 of 11 shots with three 3-pointers and added six assists. Jimmy Oladokun Jr. finished with 15 points, seven rebounds and three blocks. Quante Berry scored 27 to lead the Cardinals (3-2), but he missed 9 of 10 shots from 3-point range. Niccolo Moretti contributed 18 points and seven assists. Rice led 43-32 at halftime. ------ Sign up for Top 25 poll alerts here, visit the Top 25 here and see AP’s full men’s basketball coverage here
